voiceNote: Kokoro af_bella (Coach Bella), generated by the lead

chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2012
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal World Cup. Spain play Morocco and lead three one. Torras works the ball on the left and crosses. Big Fernandão chests it into the net! Four one!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. He puts his big body in the way, and in it goes off his chest. Spain win five one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: He is a pivot. This is how he does it: back to goal, he shields the ball with his size, feels the defender, turns and shoots!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: use your size to shield the ball, then turn and shoot!
